title: WS B Track S: second researcher Owain Evans (consent, Exa harvest, time split, E2)
body: Ethan added Owain Evans 2026-11-14 as a second Track S researcher (PLAN §6.3). Run the same timesplit/track_eval stages into data/researchers/owain_evans/. Blockers: (1) consent not asked yet, see CONSENT.md; (2) timesplit.py hardcodes Marius: BANNED = hobbhahn|marius|apollo in check_pair, and exclude_text=['Hobbhahn'] / exclude_domains=['apolloresearch.ai'] in the contemporaneous-distractor search. Make those per-researcher (name + org) before running Owain.
